name: 10586-mtpdecode-qwen3next80b-tp4
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one node (--gres=gpu:8, four used).
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism and NO DP attention.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, 80B total / ~3B active, bf16, no quantization_config. 48 layers, hybrid attention: 12 full-attention and 36 Gated-DeltaNet. ~160 GB of weights, ~40 GB per rank at TP4. The checkpoint ships a NEXTN multi-token-prediction head, which this setup turns on.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix structure: 256 prompt tokens in (stdev 64), 512 generated out (stdev 64). Seed 0.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant with multi-token prediction, serving 256 concurrent short-prompt, long-answer requests on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang launch arguments for this item.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 4

# The checkpoint's own NEXTN draft head: three draft steps, one top-1 candidate per step, four
# tokens per verify. `speculative-algorithm` is the ServerArgs field; `--speculative-algo` is an
# alias of it.
speculative-algorithm: NEXTN
speculative-num-steps: 3
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 0

# max-mamba-cache-size, max-running-requests and mamba-ssm-dtype are unset on purpose, so the
# engine takes 512 / 512 / float32. Setting max-running-requests ALSO sets the recurrent-state
# cache size, since the engine copies one into the other when the latter is unset.
# attention-backend and disable-radix-cache are unset because the engine overrides both for this
# architecture whatever is passed here.
